notes: Check with your high school counselor to see if your school takes part.
name: Greater Lafayette Career+ HireMe! (career event for high school juniors and seniors)
what_you_do: A yearly event for high school juniors and seniors. You meet hiring managers from local companies like Subaru, Wabash, Kirby Risk, IU Health and Caterpillar. You explore careers. You can land internships or jobs. The focus is on making things and health care.
who_can_apply: Juniors and seniors from partner regional high schools. The page does not say how a student signs up, so ask your school counselor.
deadline_text: The page says the next event is Wednesday, April 29, 2026 at the Tippecanoe County Fairgrounds, which has passed. A 2027 date is not posted.
how_to_apply: Not stated. Students take part through their partner high school.
